# Vennir

> Vennir is an open-source platform (MIT License) that runs DAGs of containerized steps as Kubernetes Jobs. Each step is a product that a platform team published and reviewed, running as its own Kubernetes ServiceAccount with only its own team's secrets, and handing its outputs to the next step. Other teams order those products from a catalog in a web console, through an API, or from CI, without ever holding the credentials the products use. Current version: 0.11.0 (0.x: not production-ready yet).

Key facts:

- Runs on Kubernetes 1.30 or later with a NetworkPolicy-enforcing network plugin: kind on a laptop, GKE, EKS, or an existing cluster. Installed with the `vennir` CLI or two Helm charts (Helm 4).
- A product is a container image plus a `product.yaml` contract: actions with JSON Schema inputs and outputs, the ServiceAccount it runs as, which teams may run it, approvals, and error explanations. Products live in a team's catalog repository; CI builds, tests, scans and signs each image, then publishes one signed catalog release that every install pulls.
- Security is checked twice: by the console, and again by Kubernetes admission policies on every Job (allowed namespaces and image sources, images pinned to a digest and scanned, each product's own identity, each team's registered secrets only).
- Cloud access is by federation where possible (GKE Workload Identity, EKS Pod Identity, short-lived tokens), not stored keys.
- Free and open source; you pay only for the cluster and the cloud resources your products create.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vennir.io/): what Vennir is, how a run works, security, ordering, installing
- [FAQ](https://vennir.io/faq): short answers to common questions
- [Product tour](https://vennir.io/product): the catalog, templates, ordering, the API gateway, Observe, the chat agent, the CLI, and what isn't done yet
- [Use cases](https://vennir.io/use-cases): the repository's samples, on Google Cloud, AWS and no cloud
- [Security model](https://vennir.io/security): what's enforced, by which layer, and what isn't yet
- [Get started](https://vennir.io/get-started): installing on kind, GKE, EKS or your own cluster, then a first catalog and run
- [Docs](https://vennir.io/docs): every guide, grouped by reader
- [Changelog](https://vennir.io/changelog): each release
- [Community](https://vennir.io/community): contributing, reporting a vulnerability, the roadmap
